mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month indicates economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) grows by less than 1% annually, it signals a tightening monetary policy without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over a 3-month period, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals robust consumer demand and a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp.
